name: Platform of Payments and Sales Simple
description: Lets users pay for services/purchases via payment gateways in a simple block.
project_description:
The major of service agencies sales only a few subscription plans and not need a big ecommerce platform for make that. The main purpose of this module is help to this agencies get the work done without painless.

 This module per se don't do anything, but in conjunction to payments gateways provides a simple way to sales monthly o yearly recurrent subscription plans.

 Instructions 

 
 Download and enable Platform of Payments and Sales Simple integration module to your Drupal site. 
 Select the payment gateway you like to use. 
 Select the content types to enable pay button. 
 Enter return url when a successful sale is made. 
 Enter return url when an error occurs in the sale. 
 
 Features 
 Provides a button to purchase a subscription plan like you can see here.
